description: This Java source file defines the class JFontChooser, a custom font selection dialog that allows users to choose font family, size, style (bold/italic), and provides a sample display. It is part of the package ZoeloeSoft.projects.JFontChooser.

classes.name: JFontChooser
classes.description: A dialog window that enables users to select a font, including its family, size, and style, and preview the selection.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays the font chooser dialog and returns the selected option (OK or Cancel).

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the current font for the font chooser and updates UI components accordingly.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the font selected by the user if OK was pressed; otherwise, null.

methods.name: getCurrentFont
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Font object based on user selections in the dialog.
